children: According to the financial calendar of Goobit Group AB (publ), available on the Company's website and stated in previously published reports, the annual report for the financial year 2025-05-01 to 2026-04-30 was to be published on 20 September 2026. The audit process has taken longer than planned, and the Company will therefore not be able to publish the annual report on the date stated in the financial calendar.
The Company now expects to publish the annual report no later than Wednesday, 23 September 2026.

The annual general meeting remains planned for 15 October 2026 as previously notified, and the revised publication date does not affect the Company's ability to meet the applicable deadlines ahead of the meeting.

Goobit Group AB (publ) operates in the financial sector and offers Bitcoin-focused services under the BTCX brand. Under the Futureproof brand, the group is developing a savings platform for bitcoin, gold and interest-bearing assets. The group consists of the wholly owned subsidiaries Goobit AB and Goobit Blocktech AB and is headquartered in Stockholm.
